scripts.build: echo "🔍 Validating CPI Artifacts..." && FILE=$(find iflows -name '*.zip' | tail -1) && BASENAME=$(basename $FILE) && echo "Processing $FILE" && unzip -t "$FILE" && mkdir -p dist && cp "$FILE" dist/$BASENAME && echo "📦 Uploading to Nexus..." && curl -u $nexuscredential_usr:$nexuscredential_psw -T dist/$BASENAME $ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME && echo "✅ Uploaded Successfully"
